relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed decreased m6A levels and upregulated FTO expression in the CSF-contacting nucleus of SNI mice.

relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: In CSF-contacting nucleus, FTO overexpression reduced m6A methylation and promoted pain

relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: the m6A demethylase FTO contributes to NP by upregulating the expression of P2rx4 mRNA and protein through mediating m6A demethylation of P2rx4 mRNA

relationships.subject: meclofenamic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of the FTO inhibitor meclofenamic acid (MA) into CSF-contacting nucleus alleviated pain.

relationships.subject: FTO
relationships.evidence_quote: FTO overexpression reduced m6A methylation and promoted pain, while FTO inhibition increased m6A levels and alleviated pain hypersensitivity

key_findings: FTO is upregulated in the CSF-contacting nucleus after SNI and drives pain by m6A demethylation of P2rx4 mRNA.
FTO inhibition with meclofenamic acid raised m6A and relieved hypersensitivity.
